preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract to call the setMaxTxPercent function.

exploit_hint: The attacker, who must be the contract owner, should call the `setMaxTxPercent` function with the argument `0`. This sets the `_maxTxAmount` state variable to zero. As a result, any transfer from a user not excluded from the max transaction limit will fail the `require(amount <= _maxTxAmount)` check, effectively halting token transfers for regular users.
